response.note: This shows the daily success-rate trend for October 2026 to locate when the change occurred; the 'why' needs follow-up breakdowns by acquirer, issuer, method, or failure_category, and the status value 'SUCCESS' is assumed.
response.sql: SELECT txn_date, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' GROUP BY txn_date ORDER BY txn_date LIMIT 50
